name: Feasible Region Projection
description: Replaced the direct "mathematically incompatible" wording with a topological description of the feasible region's projection onto the completion time axis. By describing the isolated constraint subsystems as producing a closed ray whose infimum must exceed T + 1, models are forced to algebraically derive that the infimum corresponds to the sum of processing times, rather than relying on surface-level pattern matching of impossibility certificates.
